diagrams.name: Amazon RDS Multi-AZ Instance Deployment
diagrams.desc: An application writes through the DB instance endpoint to the primary, which replicates synchronously to a standby in another Availability Zone. Packets show a write, then AZ a failing, the standby being promoted and the endpoint CNAME flipping to it.

diagrams.name: Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB Cluster
diagrams.desc: A Multi-AZ DB cluster has one writer and two readable standby DB instances in three Availability Zones, replicated semisynchronously. Packets show a write through the cluster endpoint, its replication and acknowledgment, then reads through the reader endpoint.

diagrams.name: Amazon RDS Proxy Connection Pooling
diagrams.desc: A fleet of AWS Lambda functions opens many connections to Amazon RDS Proxy, which pools them into a few reused connections to the RDS or Aurora database and reads the credentials from AWS Secrets Manager. Packets show requests converging, being multiplexed, and responses fanning back out.

diagrams.name: Amazon ElastiCache Cache-Aside
diagrams.desc: The application checks Amazon ElastiCache first; on a miss it queries Amazon RDS and writes the result back to the cache. Packets show a miss that fills the cache, then a hit that never reaches the database.
diagrams.extra: <text class="t-wire" x="308" y="114"><tspan x="308">GET / SET with TTL</tspan></text><text class="t-wire" x="308" y="204"><tspan x="308">SQL query on a miss</tspan></text><text style="text-anchor:start;font-size:8.5px;fill:var(--awd-muted);" x="100" y="232"><tspan x="100">Cache-aside: read the cache first,</tspan><tspan x="100" dy="10.5">query RDS only on a miss, then</tspan><tspan x="100" dy="10.5">fill the cache for the next read.</tspan></text><g class="anim" opacity="0"><rect x="96" y="222" width="150" height="38" style="fill:var(--awd-panel)"/><text style="text-anchor:start;font-size:8.5px;fill:var(--awd-pk);" x="100" y="232"><tspan x="100">Request 1, cache miss: read</tspan><tspan x="100" dy="10.5">RDS, then fill the cache.</tspan></text><animate attributeName="opacity" dur="10s" repeatCount="indefinite" calcMode="discrete" values="0;1;0" keyTimes="0;.01;.6"/></g><g class="anim" opacity="0"><rect x="96" y="222" width="150" height="38" style="fill:var(--awd-panel)"/><text style="text-anchor:start;font-size:8.5px;fill:var(--awd-pk);" x="100" y="232"><tspan x="100">Request 2, cache hit: answered</tspan><tspan x="100" dy="10.5">from memory, RDS not touched.</tspan></text><animate attributeName="opacity" dur="10s" repeatCount="indefinite" calcMode="discrete" values="0;1;0" keyTimes="0;.6;1"/></g>

diagrams.name: Amazon DynamoDB Global Tables
diagrams.desc: A DynamoDB global table keeps a replica in each Region and replicates changes both ways, so users write locally in either Region and concurrent updates resolve by last writer wins. Packets show a write in us-east-1 reaching eu-west-1, then a write in eu-west-1 reaching us-east-1.
diagrams.extra: <text class="t-wire" style="text-anchor:end;" x="348" y="161.5"><tspan x="348">Asynchronous replication</tspan></text><text class="t-wire" style="text-anchor:start;" x="380" y="161.5"><tspan x="380">Last writer wins</tspan></text>

diagrams.name: Amazon RDS Read Replicas
diagrams.desc: A source DB instance replicates asynchronously to two read replicas in other AZs and to a cross-Region read replica, which can serve local reads or be promoted for disaster recovery. Packets show a write, the replication fan-out, then reads from each replica.

diagrams.desc: The primary Region cluster replicates at the storage layer to a secondary Region, typically with under one second of lag, and a managed failover or switchover promotes the secondary. Packets show replication, then a Region outage, the promotion and Route 53 redirecting writes.

diagrams.name: AWS Database Migration Service
diagrams.desc: AWS DMS copies an on-premises database into Amazon Aurora over Direct Connect or VPN, first as a full load and then as ongoing change data capture, with the optional AWS Schema Conversion Tool preparing the target schema. Packets show schema conversion, the bulk load, then change replication.
